plugins.name: glasser-seo-audit
plugins.description: SEO audit of your own website on data from Semrush, Ahrefs, DataForSEO and Serpstat. Give a domain and get technical and on-page health, rankings, keyword opportunities, competitors and keyword gaps, backlinks, search results and AI search visibility, scored and turned into a prioritised action plan. Run it again to see what changed. Requires a Glasser account.
